correctness.rationale: The graph has unique start-column assignment and cyclic separation, giving an exact n//2 upper bound. A complete two-column transition table, a twisted-seam parity check, a first-horizontal-to-rung normalization, and an exhaustive accounting of the two support-shift exchanges reconstruct all quantifiers, boundary n=4 and exact degrees. Independent exhaustive Python implementations from two unrelated graph presentations agree n=4..12; the infinite conclusion rests on a combinatorial proof rather than finite testing.
